name: Pomodoro
summary: A focus and break timer in the notch
description: Pick Focus or Break, set any length from a minute to eight hours and start the timer from the notch. The countdown runs beside the notch with a progress ring, on the lock screen and on a Home widget that also shows on your iPhone. Pause, resume or stop it from any of them or with a keyboard shortcut. Give a session a title, play brown or pink noise while it runs, and hear a chime when it ends.
author: Sumit
